name: FerroBRIDGEAdministrativeGenderToHl70001
title: FerroBRIDGE supplement: administrative-gender to HL7 table 0001
description: Adds the FHIR-to-v2 direction of ConceptMap/table-hl70001-to-administrative-gender of hl7.fhir.uv.v2mappings 1.0.0, which maps v2 to FHIR only. Reversed, that map gives other three sources (O, A and N), so the inverse would have no single code to write; this map names O (Other) for other, since A (Ambiguous) and N (Not applicable) state why no sex is given, and each other code its one source. Used by the PID inverse of FerroBRIDGE #1716.
